name: Gargoyle Wing

items.name: Death From Above
items.text:
Trigger The gargoyle wing is Flying, and a creature moves into an adjacent square below it

---
Effect The gargoyle wing swoops down with their talons. The triggering creature takes 2d8+9 slashing damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: Catch and Release
items.text: The gargoyle wing attempts an Athletics checks to grapple, comparing the result to the Fortitude DC of a number of Large or smaller creatures in a 5-foot emanation equal to the gargoyle wing's remaining number of segments, then Flies up to 40 feet, bringing any successfully Grabbed or Restrained creatures along, and Releases them.

items.name: Raking Swoop
items.text:
1 to 3

Frequency once per round

---
Effect The gargoyle wing rips and tears with their stony talons at each enemy in a 5-foot emanation (DC 28 basic Reflex save save). The damage dealt depends on the number of actions.

1 1d8+2 slashing damage

2 2d8+9 slashing damage

3 3d8+11 slashing damage

text: Normally solitary beasts that lurk in abandoned temples and other structures that afford them a place to hide among appropriately monstrous statuary, gargoyles occasionally band together to hunt challenging prey or simply to take communal pleasure in slaughtering the defenseless. Called wings, these groupings are usually short-lived, though that matters little to those who fall victim to their predations in the meantime.
